title: Home
text:
Public Transport • Travel Behaviour • Transport Safety • Transport Planning

I am a transport engineer and researcher specializing in public transport, travel behaviour, transport safety, and transport planning. My research combines behavioural modelling, policy analysis, and evidence-based planning to improve transport systems and mobility outcomes, particularly in developing and emerging economies.

Welcome to my academic website. This platform showcases my research, publications, projects, teaching activities, and professional contributions in transport and mobility.
As my academic career develops, this website will continue to grow with new research projects, publications, collaboration opportunities, and student supervision information.
